subject: Request: cohort seed credits + SOC2 evidence for VetLabs accelerator
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@vetlabs.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:22 -0700
Subject: VetLabs accelerator — credits for upcoming cohort + SOC2 evidence

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking a quick look. We run a three-week technical accelerator for early-stage bio startups and are evaluating Redwood for in-program credits and a short trial extension while teams complete model PoCs. Two asks from our side: 

1) A one-time allocation of $5k in credits per cohort (we run quarterly, ~8 startups/cohort).
2) A 30-day trial extension for the teams so they can run longer finetuning/eval loops.

Also, our procurement team has asked for SOC2 summary evidence and a short statement on data retention for sandboxed projects (we're not sending PHI). Can you point me to the right contact or attach the doc?

I attached a one-pager about the accelerator.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call to align.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Program Director, VetLabs
[Attachment: vetlabs-accelerator-one-pager.pdf (pdf)]

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lopez <anna@vetlabs.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: VetLabs accelerator — credits for upcoming cohort + SOC2 evidence

Hi Anna,

Really appreciate the one-pager — this looks promising. Short answers up front: we can do cohort credit grants and a 30-day trial extension for participating teams; approvals are typically bundled with a simple SOW and a usage milestone so we can track credit consumption and prevent abuse.

I'll loop in Marissa from Partnerships for the credit approval and Karthik from RevOps for billing/contract questions. Marissa — can you confirm the standard accelerator grant flow and whether a $5k per cohort allocation is within our partner discretionary budget, or whether this needs a deals desk ticket?

Marissa, attaching VetLabs one-pager. Anna — I'll also send our SOC2 summary once Marissa confirms.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, Anna Lopez <anna@vetlabs.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:37:05 -0700
Subject: Re: VetLabs accelerator — credits for upcoming cohort + SOC2 evidence

Hi team — thanks for the intro. Quick internal note: we have an accelerators discretionary pool that can cover promotional grants up to $40k QTD; $5k/cohort (x4 cohorts = $20k/yr) is within range but needs a signed accelerator agreement and a HubSpot deal to track redemption.

Anna, next steps I recommend:
- Sign the Accelerator Credit Agreement (I can share a template)
- We provision a promo code per cohort and a 30-day trial extension applied to registered team accounts
- Milestone: credit redemption report after the first month for continued allocation

I'll attach the SOC2 vendor summary and a short credit TOS for legal. Marissa

[Attachment: vendor-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: redwood-credit-tos.pdf (pdf)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, Anna Lopez <anna@vetlabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:14:44 -0700
Subject: Re: VetLabs accelerator — credits for upcoming cohort + SOC2 evidence

Hi Anna — Karthik on RevOps. A couple of operational clarifications: 

1) We can issue cohort promo codes that expire after 90 days; each code can be tied to an HubSpot company/deal so we can reconcile usage.
2) For the 30-day trial extension we usually attach it to an email invite flow and require teams to register under the VetLabs workspace (this helps with access and billing ownership).

If the accelerator wants invoices or a PO for the credits, we'll need the signed agreement + a HubSpot deal with billing contact and PO number. If not, we can provision credits on a goodwill basis while the paperwork is in progress.

Irene/Marissa — sounds like legal will want to review the credit TOS; looping them in if needed.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Simon Turner <simon.turner@vetlabs.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: VetLabs accelerator — credits for upcoming cohort + SOC2 evidence

Thanks — this is great. We can sign the Accelerator Credit Agreement and provide PO info next week. Two quick questions before we finalize: 

• Can promo codes be restricted so startups only use them for inference/hosting (i.e., prevent being applied to managed services we don't intend to cover)?
• Any limit on per-team spend to prevent a single team exhausting the whole cohort pot?

If those two controls are doable, we are happy to move forward. Also, Anna and I are free Tue 11/2 10–11 PT if you want a 20-min call to review the agreement and onboarding checklist.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Simon Turner
COO, VetLabs
